lemma IsExactOn.with_val_at {f : ℂ → E} {s : Set ℂ} (h : IsExactOn f s) (x₀ : ℂ) (y : E) :
    ∃ g, g x₀ = y ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, HasDerivAt g (f x) x := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ := h
  use fun z ↦ η z - η x₀ + y, by simp, by simpa using hη
